verdict.rationale: Metorial clearly has a large pre-built catalog: the README cites 1200+ integrations across SaaS tools, enterprise systems, data sources and custom MCP servers. The docs refer to 'the Metorial catalog', and a key-gated /providers API endpoint exists. Portals also let users discover approved integrations. None of the evidence shows the developer-facing ability to search or filter that catalog by capability, or to inspect each server's tools before wiring it into an agent; this is only implied. missing for 10: documented catalog search/filter by capability, per-server tool listings visible before connection, hands-on or independent corroboration of catalog browsing.
